kus: KU1. how to prepare for lessons
KU2. expected timelines and budget constraints to aid realistic goal achievement

KU5. create an Inclusive Classroom and engage students of all learning styles, backgrounds, and
KU6. basic and advance concepts of music theory and harmonic principles

KU16. define the levels of proficiency of the learners by developing rubrics of performance criteria
gs: GS1. read music and hear notes
GS2. comprehend music theory concepts
GS3. prepare concept notes and style guides to aid music composition from information gathered
GS4. provide clear written guidelines to learners while assigning music composition tasks.
GS5. involve learners in deciding on a concert theme and in choosing some of the music, if appropriate
GS6. conceptualize music using wider music options
GS7. read and comprehend music briefs, scripts, storyboards etc.
GS8. research and gather relevant information related to genre, language, cultural and regional
GS9. stay abreast with the trends and developments in the global music industry through regular
GS10. discuss, clarify and teach learners to play music by ear and improvise
GS11. present/solicit feedback on learners' performance and identify the modifications required.
GS12. explain the creative concept to the learner to prepare music adapts and demos.

GS14. vary the difficulty of the music selected for learners to master not more than two or three
GS15. organize the learning objectives and timelines according to the lesson plan.
GS16. conduct review sessions to ensure timely progress of learners' skills on vocal singing and
GS17. analyse the impact of creative choices on the overall music concept.
GS18. assess the budgetary implications of realising creative choices while composing music.
GS19. address and resolve any fundamental challenges in finalising the creative concept and music
GS20. choose music and get learners started on practicing using established criteria and make improvements where required.
GS21. provide constructive feedback to learners while reviewing music adapts and compositions.
GS22. make appropriate choices of compositional techniques to meet the creative concept requirements.
GS23. teach innovative and unconventional approaches to compose music that appeal to the current and emerging preferences of the target audience.
GS24. review the work of self and learners at every stage to ensure that they fully meet the performance criteria laid out in the lesson plan

modules.module_title: Identify the learning objectives

pcs.pc_description: describe the essential learning goals that a learner must achieve in measurable terms within the specified time
ensure that all learners, including those with disabilities or constraints, have a fair chance of achieving learning goals

modules.module_title: Plan the specific learning activities

pcs.pc_description: align learning activity to the lesson’s learning objectives
meaningfully engage students in active, constructive, authentic, and collaborative ways,
provide students with opportunities to think about or use knowledge and information in new and different ways

modules.module_title: Plan to sequence the lesson in an engaging and meaningful manner

pcs.pc_description: utilize ice breaker activities, technologies such as clickers, current news and events, case studies etc to gain learner's attention
include learning objectives in lecture slides, the syllabus, and in instructions for activities, projects and papers and criteria for standard performance
sequence and chunk the information to avoid cognitive overload
model varied learning strategies – mnemonics, concept mapping, role playing, visualizing and provide instructional support as needed

modules.module_title: Plan to assess student understanding

pcs.pc_description: develop rubrics/criteria to ensure consistency in the evaluation of learners’ work
list ways to collect evidence of learner's learning.
select appropriate assessment methods to measure learning objectives

modules.module_title: Plan for a lesson closure

pcs.pc_description: check for learners' understanding and inform subsequent instruction (adjust your teaching accordingly)
consolidate and summarize key information

modules.module_title: Read and Hear Music Notes

pcs.pc_description: read and name notes on Sheet Music
recognize sharps and flats, Scales and Keys
read the speed of a piece of music and play it on an instrument
read the grouping of the beats through the time ,signatures, bars and barlines
calculate the length of a note and discuss the importance of impact of dots and ties on a note’s length

pcs.pc_description: explain compositional elements such as song form, tempo, notes, chords, key signatures, intervals, scales
explore musical qualities such as pitch, tone, timbre, texture, dynamics,
read and clap different rhythms, spot rests and understand triplets
encourage learners to build chord progressions and melodies
model appropriate technical, musical, and artistic concepts and skills to promote a sense of ownership, and support people in becoming independent musical learners and musical decision-makers
support learners in developing safe and appropriate musical techniques (including instrumental care and hygiene) in order to promote physical, vocal and auditory health
employ a range of strategies to overcome barriers to musical learning experienced by individuals and/or group

decide and organise dress code for musicians or performers

pcs.pc_description: take consent of the parents and inform them of the dates and roles
design the flyers, and other print and social media content to promote a concert.

pcs.pc_description: determine and sell tickets at an appropriate price
contact local newspapers and radio stations and local organisations to promote the concert

pcs.pc_description: identify the type of assessment to be carried out (diagnostic, summative, formative etc.)
align assessment methods, items, and tasks to match learning objectives
list and use measurement tools most appropriate as per the assessment type.(such as checklist or rating scales etc.)

pcs.pc_description: identify the learning objective to be tested.
define the task or activity and break the task into component parts.
clearly define the standard for each level of proficiency
provide criteria for interpreting the final score

pcs.pc_description: make use of technology to collect and analyse evidence of assessment
encourage learners to self assess their expressive and creative development.
give learners regular verbal or written feedback that includes praise and identifies areas for improvement

modules.module_title: Understanding the health, safety and security risks prevalent in the workplace

pcs.pc_description: understand and comply with the organizations current health, safety and security policies and procedures
understand the safe working practices pertaining to own occupation
understand the government norms and policies relating to health and safety including emergency procedures for illness, accidents, fires or others which may involve evacuation of the premises
participate in organization health and safety knowledge sessions and drills

modules.module_title: Knowing the people responsible for health and safety and the resources available

pcs.pc_description: identify the people responsible for health and safety in the workplace, including those to contact in case of an emergency
identify security signals e.g. fire alarms and places such as staircases, fire warden stations, first aid and medical rooms

modules.module_title: Identifying and reporting risks

pcs.pc_description: identify aspects of your workplace that could cause potential risk to own and others health and safety
ensure own personal health and safety, and that of others in the workplace though precautionary measures
identify and recommend opportunities for improving health, safety, and security to the designated person
report any hazards outside the individuals authority to the relevant person in line with organizational procedures and warn other people who may be affected

modules.module_title: Complying with procedures in the event of an emergency

pcs.pc_description: follow organizations emergency procedures for accidents, fires or any other natural calamity in case of a hazard
identify and correct risks like illness, accidents, fires or any other natural calamity safely and within the limits of individuals authority
